---
title: "TAOOH — imputation"
subtitle: "Patient-level baseline-covariate imputation"
format: html
---

- Weekly outcome is not imputed (no intermittent missing states)

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(here)
library(arrow)
library(yaml)
library(mice)
library(tidyverse)

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))
source(here("R", "plot-style.R"))

indices <- seq_len(config$imputation$m_main)

results_dir <- here("analysis", "04-taooh", "results")
imputation_dir <- here(results_dir, "imputations")
dir.create(imputation_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Patient-level imputation data

```{r}
#| label: build-imputation-data
#| include: false

prepared <- read_parquet(here(results_dir, "prepared.parquet")) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  mutate(
    diagnosis = factor(diagnosis),
    ecog_fstcnt = factor(ecog_fstcnt, levels = 0:3, ordered = TRUE)
  )

history_summaries <- prepared |>
  group_by(id) |>
  summarise(
    n_alive = sum(y %in% 1:4, na.rm = TRUE),
    no_alive_history = as.integer(n_alive == 0L),
    prop_planned_admission = if_else(
      n_alive > 0,
      sum(y == 2L, na.rm = TRUE) / n_alive,
      0
    ),
    prop_er = if_else(
      n_alive > 0,
      sum(y == 3L, na.rm = TRUE) / n_alive,
      0
    ),
    prop_unplanned_admission = if_else(
      n_alive > 0,
      sum(y == 4L, na.rm = TRUE) / n_alive,
      0
    ),
    n_from_home = sum(yprev == 1L & y %in% 1:4, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_acute_from_home = sum(yprev == 1L & y %in% c(3L, 4L), na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_acute_from_home = if_else(
      n_from_home > 0,
      n_acute_from_home / n_from_home,
      0
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

patient_data <- prepared |>
  select(
    id,
    tx,
    age,
    gender,
    diagnosis,
    ecog_fstcnt,
    albumin,
    bilirubin,
    c_reactive_protein,
    lactate_dehydrogenase,
    survival_time_days,
    event_death
  ) |>
  distinct() |>
  left_join(history_summaries, by = "id") |>
  mutate(
    tx = factor(tx),
    gender = factor(gender),
    event_death = as.integer(event_death)
  )

patient_data$na_est <- nelsonaalen(
  patient_data,
  survival_time_days,
  event_death
)

# The column order fixes the mice visit sequence.
imputation_data <- patient_data |>
  select(-survival_time_days, -n_acute_from_home, -n_alive)
```

```{r}
#| label: imputation-model
#| include: false

methods <- make.method(imputation_data)
methods[] <- ""
methods["ecog_fstcnt"] <- "polr"
methods[c(
  "albumin",
  "bilirubin",
  "c_reactive_protein",
  "lactate_dehydrogenase"
)] <- "pmm"

predictors <- make.predictorMatrix(imputation_data)
predictors[, "id"] <- 0
```

## Imputation per index

```{r}
#| label: impute
#| include: false

for (index in indices) {
  imputation_path <- here(
    imputation_dir,
    sprintf("imputation-%02d.rds", index)
  )
  if (file.exists(imputation_path)) next

  imputation <- mice(
    data = imputation_data,
    method = methods,
    predictorMatrix = predictors,
    m = 1,
    maxit = config$imputation$maxit,
    donors = config$imputation$donors,
    # The +300 offset keeps seeds distinct from the OS imputations.
    seed = config$seeds$imputation + (index - 1L) * 1000L + 300L,
    printFlag = FALSE
  )

  saveRDS(imputation, imputation_path, compress = "xz")
}

imputations <- indices |>
  map(\(index) {
    readRDS(here(imputation_dir, sprintf("imputation-%02d.rds", index)))
  })
```

## Completed weekly datasets

```{r}
#| label: completed-data
#| include: false

longitudinal_data <- prepared |>
  select(id, week, y, yprev, ypprev)

for (index in indices) {
  completed_baseline <- complete(imputations[[index]], 1) |>
    select(
      id,
      tx,
      age,
      gender,
      diagnosis,
      ecog_fstcnt,
      albumin,
      bilirubin,
      c_reactive_protein,
      lactate_dehydrogenase
    )

  completed <- longitudinal_data |>
    left_join(completed_baseline, by = "id") |>
    mutate(
      yprev = factor(yprev, levels = 1:4),
      ypprev = factor(ypprev, levels = 1:4),
      id = factor(id)
    )

  write_parquet(
    completed,
    here(imputation_dir, sprintf("completed-%02d.parquet", index)),
    compression = "zstd"
  )
}
```

## Convergence and imputed distributions

```{r}
#| label: combine-imputations
#| include: false

# One imputed column per imputation index.
imputation_combined <- Reduce(ibind, imputations)

laboratory_values <- imputed_values(
  imputation_combined,
  c(
    Albumin = "albumin",
    Bilirubin = "bilirubin",
    "C-reactive protein" = "c_reactive_protein",
    "Lactate dehydrogenase" = "lactate_dehydrogenase"
  )
)

ecog_proportions <- imputed_category_proportions(
  imputation_combined,
  c("ECOG performance status" = "ecog_fstcnt")
)
```

```{r}
#| label: taooh-imputation-convergence
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "MICE convergence traces for imputed TAOOH baseline covariates."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 9

plot_mice_traces(mice_chain_stats(imputations))
```

```{r}
#| label: taooh-imputation-distributions
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Observed and imputed distributions of continuous TAOOH baseline covariates."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5

plot_imputed_densities(laboratory_values$observed, laboratory_values$imputed)
```

```{r}
#| label: taooh-imputation-categories
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Observed and imputed proportions of the ECOG performance status categories."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4

plot_imputed_categories(ecog_proportions)
```
